body:
I am very happy to have come across Mucuna pruriens. I've been buying it in supplement form, 333mg's per capsule, standardized to 50mg levodopa per cap. Levodopa is the precursor to dopamine.
The effects are almost purely dopaminergic, though I notice some slight adrenergic effects, since dopamine converts to norepinephrine and epinephrine in the body. If you do not like adrenergic effects then advise against ingesting too much vitamin C (ascorbic acid) along with it (no more than 90-100mgs), because it can promote conversion of dopamine to norepinephrine. However I advise taking vitamin B6 (pyridoxine), because it's essential to convert levodopa to dopamine, and also a decarboxylase inhibitor to prevent the vitamin B6 wastefully being used to prematurely convert the levodopa before it passes the BBB. A natural decarboxylase inhibitor would be EGCG, commonly found in Camillia sinensis tea (white, green, oolong, or black tea), cocoa, fruits, vegetables, and wine. Their is also carbidopa - a prescription decarboxylase inhibitor commonly prescribed along with levodopa for treatment of parkinsons, a disease caused by severe deficiency in levodopa.
Due to the presence nicotine and 5-htp, their should also be some mild cholinergic and serotoninergic effects, though i've never had pure levodopa, so it's difficult for me to discern if their is any. The other psychadelic alkaloids aren't active orally without an MAOI, but can be smoked. I've attempted to smoke mucuna pruriens once, but since it's adulturated with millet, it makes it almost impossible to smoke, it just turns into black goo that would surely ruin your pipe.
The actual effects are as listed:
- Pleasant internal warmth/increased body temperature - identical to the one I get with mu-agonist opioids. That particular effect along with many others of them is actually because of dopamine.
- Mood lift, euphoria
- Increase concentration - mostly an increase in mental energy and ability to focus.
- Increased motivation
- Increased talkativeness
- Reduced appetite
- Increased heart and breathing rate. Breathing is also more satisfying, like your lungs are getting filled more with clean air.
- Increased libido/desire for sex
I think this herbal supplement would be great for treating illnesses and ailments such as ADD, parkinson, chronic fatique syndrome, low pain threshold. Though I highly advise against taking it if you suffer from shitzophrenia or other psychological disorders, as it can excerbate them.
